rule_proposal: sbc_after_tax_gross_up (NEW, needs a ruling): where no CF add-back and no pre-tax expense is printed, sbc = after-tax compensation expense + "income tax benefit recognized in earnings" from the same filing. Hold until ruled: the benefit can include excess tax benefits, breaking the identity (2016). No absence HIDE (ruling 4).
